Heads up: this picture is 75 days old, so treat it as a snapshot from 2026-03-29, not a live view.

The single biggest line in your spending is **housing** — €2,850 across 3 transactions, all to Alquiler Piso, making up 53% of everything tracked. After that, **eating & drinking out** at €762 and **groceries** at €672 round out the top three. Nothing is uncategorised, which means the picture is clean.

With €2,700 coming in and €1,242 in fixed costs, free cash flow sits at €1,458 a month. You've already saved €1,200 toward the €6,000 move-home fund — €4,800 left to go. That math is solvable, but right now there's no target date, which means there's no monthly pace to aim at. That's the one thing standing between you and a real plan.

Fifteen transactions over 88 days is thin for pattern-spotting, so the behavioural read will sharpen as more data comes in.

Set a date and the required monthly contribution becomes a number, not a guess.

[CTA:supply_input]Set a target date for Move-home fund[/CTA]
